scope: Chromium 151 CDP trusted touch A/B on actual Deck source with external backend/native fixtures. Trace entry counts include scoped and instant entries, so they are not unique gesture counts. Physical Android was not verified.
finding: The native browser fling controller consumes GestureTapDown, GestureShowPress and GestureTap after the prior horizontal drag. Cancelling default touchmove prevents the unwanted native fling and preserves normal trusted clicks.
appChanges: None. Read-only diagnosis: style/listener changes existed only in the temporary test browser.
recommendedFix: Install mainElement.addEventListener("touchmove", handler, { passive: false }); handler calls preventDefault only if gesture.current?.dragging && event.cancelable. Remove the listener on cleanup. Preserve normal native clicks; never manually activate a button on pointerup.
